label: team_0100_cassiopeia_01
text: I see you’re almost at the fifth base...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_02
text: Holed up inside there is Team Star’s last\nremaining squad.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_03
text: You’ve fought well to make it this far.\nThank you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_04
text: So you made it as well, Clive.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_nelke_02
text: Of course—it’s the last base! I wouldn’t want to\nmiss out on the action![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_05
text: Clive...I owe you my thanks. Your help has been\ninvaluable to the operation.\c\nI’m sorry I was so wary of you at first...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_nelke_03
text: Well...that’s all water under the bridge.\c\nWhen we’re finished with this base, will that be\nthe end of Operation Starfall, then?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_06
text: Not quite. We’ll still need to handle Team Star’s\nsecret mastermind last of all.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_nelke_04
text: Do we have any leads on how to find them?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_07
text: I’m hoping they’ll come out into the open once\nall the squad bosses have stepped down.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_cassiopeia_08
text: We’ve come so far. Only a few more steps left...\nDon’t let me down, either of you.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: team_0100_nelke_08
text: I know what I need to do... And I know what my\nfinal decision will be...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

label: team_0100_nelke_09
text:
For that, I can’t thank you enough. Take care in
that base, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
...Ah. Sorry for getting all polite there. Don’t
know what came over me.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
